name: A junk off the south China coast
summary: This drawing represents a two-masted Cantonese coastal junk with an 'eye' painted on the bows; the decoration of the stern transom often featured a bird with outstretched wings, as indicated here.  On the shore is a Chinese temple - perhaps the A-Ma temple near the south-western extremity of the Mac
